svg.desc: Original long-form visual atlas covering eleven Signals and Systems chapters with computed waveforms, spectra, sampling diagrams, transforms, pole-zero maps, and feedback-system visualizations.

svg.text: Impulse response, convolution, step response, equations

g.text: LTI system is determined by h
Probe with δ → observe h → predict response to every input by convolution.
Integrating h gives response to u
Amplitude and phase live on discrete harmonics
Finite harmonic sums sharpen jumps but overshoot
Even ↔ cosine · odd ↔ sine · real ↔ conjugate symmetry
Finite support in time spreads in frequency
Multiplication by cosine shifts the spectrum
Convolution in time ↔ multiplication in frequency
same operation viewed in the other domain
Complex exponential is an LTI eigenfunction
Passband and stopband are spectral masks
Pole proximity creates a frequency peak
A system reshapes amplitude and delay
Continuous waveform observed at uniform instants
no overlap → perfect ideal reconstruction possible
Translated message spectra appear around carrier

all poles strictly in left half-plane

svg.text: Closed loop, sensitivity, pole movement, stability
Finite words, cyclic bit geometry, modular state updates, diffusion

g.text: example word: 0x6A09E667 · 32 indexed positions · wrap is intrinsic
Overflow wraps into the same finite word space
carry is discarded · state remains 32 bits
Eight 32-bit words evolve under one repeated update law
T₁ = h + Σ₁(e) + Ch(e,f,g) + K[t] + W[t]
Two 512-bit inputs differ by one bit; compare their 256-bit digests
m₀ = 512 zero bits · m₁ differs only in its first bit
diffusion is observed here as a system response, not used as a truth criterion

svg.text: IPv4 32-bit words, IPv6 128-bit space, mapped embedding and prefix structure

g.text: Four octets are one finite 32-bit address value
The same space can be partitioned as 4×32 or 8×16
A fixed 96-bit prefix leaves exactly one 32-bit IPv4 slot
low 32 bits = 0xC0000221 · exactly the IPv4 value above
standard mapped form: 80 zero bits + 16 one bits + 32 IPv4 bits
A /64 divides a 128-bit address into two 64-bit fields
the prefix length selects a coordinate boundary inside the 128-bit state
One 32-bit value can occupy one lane without changing its internal value
the 32-bit payload is preserved exactly; only the surrounding coordinate space is enlarged

svg.text: Vector coordinates, raster frames, PNG bytes, Base64 partitions and reconstruction

g.data-equation: geometry in R² before raster sampling
g.text: The source object retains real-valued coordinates
CairoSVG samples the vector object onto an exact 160×96 pixel field
The real compressed PNG stream: signature, chunks and IDAT payload
first 8 bytes = PNG signature · following bytes begin IHDR
The same first 24 bits are repartitioned 8+8+8 → 6+6+6+6
only the partition boundaries move — “the space between”
64 symbols provide a lookup coordinate for each 6-bit value
Encoding roundtrip is exact; raster-to-vector recovery is not identity

g.text: 6 consonants × 12 vowel/mark states + one śūnya state
custom field · standard Unicode code points · not a Unicode encoding standard

canonical slot 12: ं U+0902 ANUSVARA · śūnya is abstract nil, displayed as ·

actual HSV-quantizer basin volume · not the modulo-73 reference quotient
Base64 repartitions exactly; the live HSV encoder projects many RGB states into one symbol
mod-73 remains a reference identity only; measured lossiness comes from the live HSV encoder

28 Arabic letters map directly to the classical value ladder
CULTURAL MAPPING LAYER · explicit table, variant-sensitive
charCode % 28 is excluded: it is a codepoint hash, not this mapping

this layer is a theorem about the finite state map — no book is required

ٱ→ا · ی→ي · أ/إ/آ→ا · ؤ→و · ئ/ى→ي · ة→ه
